Looks up each monster\n  # slug in the compendium and halts 404 if any slug is missing.\n  def encounter_calculation(party, monster_slugs)\n    counts = Hash.new(0)\n    monster_slugs.each { |slug| counts[slug] += 1 }\n\n    monsters = []\n    counts.each do |slug, count|\n      monster = Storage.load_monster(slug)\n      json_error(404, 'monster not found') unless monster\n      monsters << { cr: monster[:cr], count: count }\n    end\n\n    thresholds = encounter_thresholds(party)\n    base_xp, monster_count = encounter_base_xp(monsters)\n    multiplier = encounter_multiplier(monster_count)\n    adjusted_xp = (base_xp * multiplier).to_i\n    difficulty = encounter_difficulty(adjusted_xp, thresholds)\n    recommendation = recommendation_for(difficulty)\n\n    [base_xp, adjusted_xp, difficulty, monster_count, recommendation]\n  end\nend\n\n# --- Health ---\n\nget '/health' do\n  content_type :json\n  JSON.dump(ok: true)\nend\n\n# --- Core dice and checks ---\n\npost '/v1/dice/stats' do\n  content_type :json\n  body = parse_json_body\n  expression = body['expression'].to_s\n\n  match = expression.match(/^(\\d+)d(\\d+)(?:([+-])(\\d+))?$/)\n  unless match && match[1].to_i.positive? && match[2].to_i.positive?\n    halt 400, JSON.dump(error: 'invalid expression')\n  end\n\n  modifier = 0\n  if match[3]\n    modifier = match[4].to_i\n    modifier = -modifier if match[3] == '-'\n  end\n\n  dice_count = match[1].to_i\n  sides = match[2].to_i\n\n  min = dice_count + modifier\n  max = dice_count * sides + modifier\n  average = (min + max).even? ? (min + max) / 2 : (min + max) / 2.0\n\n  JSON.dump(\n    dice_count: dice_count,\n    sides: sides,\n    modifier: modifier,\n    min: min,\n    max: max,\n    average: average\n  )\nend\n\npost The sqlite3 gem connection is not thread-safe\n# across concurrent use, so the mutex guarantees a single in-flight operation at\n# a time. The connection itself is created lazily on the first call to #db.\nmodule Storage\n  DB_PATH = File.expand_path('../game.db', __dir__)\n  SCHEMA_VERSION = 1\n\n  DB_MUTEX = Mutex.new\n\n  # Returns the shared SQLite connection, lazily creating it on first use.\n  def self.db\n    @db ||= begin\n      db = SQLite3::Database.new(DB_PATH)\n      db.busy_timeout = 5000\n      db.results_as_hash = true\n      db\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Yields the shared connection while holding the storage mutex.\n  def self.with_db\n    DB_MUTEX.synchronize { yield db }\n  end\n\n  # Creates all tables and records the schema version. Safe to call repeatedly;\n  # existing tables are left untouched.\n  def self.init_schema!\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_info (\n          version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n          initialized_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )\n      SQL\n      db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO schema_info (version) VALUES (?)', [SCHEMA_VERSION])\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS combat_sessions (\n          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          round INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          turn_index INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          order_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n          combatants_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n          conditions_json TEXT NOT NULL\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n          username TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n          role TEXT NOT NULL\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compendium_monsters (\n          slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          cr TEXT NOT NULL,\n          armor_class INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          hit_points INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          tags_json TEXT NOT NULL\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compendium_items (\n          slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          type TEXT NOT NULL,\n          rarity TEXT NOT NULL,\n          cost_gp INTEGER NOT NULL\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaigns (\n          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          dm TEXT NOT NULL\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_characters (\n          campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          class TEXT NOT NULL,\n          PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, id)\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_events (\n          campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          kind TEXT NOT NULL,\n          summary TEXT NOT NULL,\n          PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, id)\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_quests (\n          campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          status TEXT NOT NULL,\n          milestones_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n          completed_milestones_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n          PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, id)\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_factions (\n          campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          stance TEXT NOT NULL,\n          PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, id)\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_npcs (\n          campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          faction_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          disposition INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, id)\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_inventory (\n          campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          item_slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n          owner TEXT NOT NULL,\n          quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, item_slug, owner)\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_crafting_projects (\n          campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          character_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          item_slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n          days_required INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          days_completed INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          status TEXT NOT NULL,\n          cost_gp INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, id)\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_sessions (\n          campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          starts_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n          duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          agenda_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n          PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, id)\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_session_attendance (\n          campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          present_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n          absent_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n          PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, session_id)\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_campaigns (\n          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          owner TEXT NOT NULL,\n          status TEXT NOT NULL,\n          phase TEXT,\n          max_players INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          current_actor TEXT,\n          turn_number INTEGER,\n          queue_json TEXT,\n          nudge_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_campaign_members (\n          campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          username TEXT NOT NULL,\n          character_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          class TEXT NOT NULL,\n          PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, username),\n          UNIQUE (campaign_id, character_id)\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      db.execute <<~SQL\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_campaign_narrations (\n          campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          kind TEXT NOT NULL,\n          actor TEXT NOT NULL,\n          type TEXT,\n          text TEXT NOT NULL,\n          PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, sequence)\n        )\n      SQL\n\n      ensure_play_campaigns_queue_column!(db)\n      ensure_play_campaign_narrations_type_column!(db)\n      ensure_play_campaigns_nudge_count_column!(db)\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Adds the queue_json column to play_campaigns if it is missing (schema\n  # migration for databases created before the exploration turn queue stage).\n  # Must be called while already holding the storage mutex.\n  def self.ensure_play_campaigns_queue_column!(db)\n    columns = db.execute('PRAGMA table_info(play_campaigns)').map { |row| row['name'] }\n    unless columns.include?('queue_json')\n      db.execute('ALTER TABLE play_campaigns ADD COLUMN queue_json TEXT')\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Adds the type column to play_campaign_narrations if it is missing (schema\n  # migration for databases created before the player action submission stage).\n  # Must be called while already holding the storage mutex.\n  def self.ensure_play_campaign_narrations_type_column!(db)\n    columns = db.execute('PRAGMA table_info(play_campaign_narrations)').map { |row| row['name'] }\n    unless columns.include?('type')\n      db.execute('ALTER TABLE play_campaign_narrations ADD COLUMN type TEXT')\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Adds the nudge_count column to play_campaigns if it is missing (schema\n  # migration for databases created before the turn timeout policy stage).\n  # Must be called while already holding the storage mutex.\n  def self.ensure_play_campaigns_nudge_count_column!(db)\n    columns = db.execute('PRAGMA table_info(play_campaigns)').map { |row| row['name'] }\n    unless columns.include?('nudge_count')\n      db.execute('ALTER TABLE play_campaigns ADD COLUMN nudge_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0')\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Drops all application tables. Used by the storage reset endpoint.\n  def self.drop_tables!\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combat_sessions')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS compendium_monsters')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS compendium_items')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_characters')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_events')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_quests')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_factions')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_npcs')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_inventory')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_crafting_projects')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_sessions')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_session_attendance')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaigns')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaign_members')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaign_narrations')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaigns')\n      db.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS schema_info')\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Destructively resets the database and re-creates the schema.\n  def self.reset!\n    drop_tables!\n    init_schema!\n  end\n\n  # Returns true when all expected tables are present in the database.\n  def self.initialized?\n    expected = %w[\n      combat_sessions users schema_info compendium_monsters compendium_items\n      campaigns campaign_characters campaign_events campaign_quests\n      campaign_factions campaign_npcs campaign_inventory\n      campaign_crafting_projects campaign_sessions\n      campaign_session_attendance play_campaigns play_campaign_members\n      play_campaign_narrations\n    ]\n\n    with_db do |db|\n      tables = db.execute(\n        \"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN (#{expected.map { '?' }.join(',')})\",\n        expected\n      )\n      tables.size == expected.size\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Combat sessions ---\n\n  def self.session_exists?(id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_session(id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      id: row['id'],\n      round: row['round'],\n      turn_index: row['turn_index'],\n      order: JSON.parse(row['order_json']),\n      combatants: JSON.parse(row['combatants_json']),\n      conditions: JSON.parse(row['conditions_json'])\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.save_session(session)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index, order_json, combatants_json, conditions_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [session[:id], session[:round], session[:turn_index], JSON.dump(session[:order]), JSON.dump(session[:combatants]), JSON.dump(session[:conditions])]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Users ---\n\n  def self.user_exists?(username)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = ?', [username]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_user(username)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?', [username]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      username: row['username'],\n      password_hash: row['password_hash'],\n      role: row['role']\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.register_user(username, password_hash, role)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',\n        [username, password_hash, role]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Compendium monsters ---\n\n  def self.monster_exists?(slug)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM compendium_monsters WHERE slug = ?', [slug]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_monster(slug)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM compendium_monsters WHERE slug = ?', [slug]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      slug: row['slug'],\n      name: row['name'],\n      cr: row['cr'],\n      armor_class: row['armor_class'],\n      hit_points: row['hit_points'],\n      tags: JSON.parse(row['tags_json'])\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.create_monster(slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO compendium_monsters (slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, JSON.dump(tags)]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  # ORDER BY rowid',\n        [campaign_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        {\n          campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n          id: row['id'],\n          title: row['title'],\n          status: row['status'],\n          milestones: JSON.parse(row['milestones_json']),\n          completed_milestones: JSON.parse(row['completed_milestones_json'])\n        }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.campaign_quests_count(campaign_id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ?', [campaign_id]) }\n  end\n\n  # --- Campaign inventory ---\n\n  def self.add_inventory_item(campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        existing = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n        )\n        if existing\n          new_quantity = existing['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.assign_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, quantity)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        party_row = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n        return false unless party_row && party_row['quantity'] >= quantity\n\n        new_party_quantity = party_row['quantity'] - quantity\n        if new_party_quantity.positive?\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_party_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'DELETE FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        end\n\n        existing_char = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n        )\n        if existing_char\n          new_char_quantity = existing_char['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_char_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.inventory_summary(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      party_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner = ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      assigned_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner != ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions = db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? The implementation is\nintentionally minimal and deterministic: no background jobs, no external\nservices, and a single SQLite database file.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nbundle install\nPORT=4567 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` starts the server in the foreground on `127.0.0.1` using the `PORT`\nenvironment variable. The same port is also read by `app.rb` as a fallback, but\n`run.sh` always passes it on the command line.\n\nVerify the server is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n```\n\nExpected response:\n\n```json\n{ \"ok\": true }\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C`.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n```\napp.rb              # Sinatra application, route definitions, request helpers\nlib/\n  auth.rb           # Password hashing (PBKDF2)\n  game_logic.rb     # Pure D&D 5e calculations and encounter constants\n  storage.rb        # SQLite persistence layer\n  validation.rb     # Input validation helpers\nrun.sh              # Foreground server launcher\nGemfile             # Pin: sinatra 4.2.1, rack 3.2.6, puma 8.0.2, sqlite3 2.9.5\n```\n\n`app.rb` requires the four libraries, configures the server bind address and\nport, initializes the SQLite schema, and then registers the helper modules and\nroutes. The app uses **classic Sinatra** style (`require 'sinatra'` and routes\ndefined at the top level) so that `ruby app.rb` works directly.\n\n## State, persistence, and request-routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db` (SQLite). The `Storage` module owns every\nSQL statement and the single shared database connection. Key facts:\n\n- `Storage::DB_PATH` resolves to the project-root `game.db`.\n- `Storage::DB_MUTEX` serializes all database access because Puma may serve\n  requests concurrently and the Ruby `sqlite3` connection object is not\n  thread-safe for unsynchronized use.\n- `Storage::SCHEMA_VERSION` is `1`. It is recorded in the `schema_info` table on\n  first boot.\n- JSON is stored as text columns (`*_json`) and parsed/serialized by the\n  storage layer.\n\nSchema is created on boot by `Storage.init_schema!`. Tables are created with\n`IF NOT EXISTS`, so restarts are safe. The `POST /v1/storage/reset` endpoint\n(and `Storage.reset!`) drops and recreates all tables for tests.\n\nTables:\n\n- `combat_sessions` — turn order, active round/turn, and per-target conditions.\n- `users` — username, password hash, role (`dm` or `player`).\n- `compendium_monsters` — stat blocks keyed by slug, including JSON tags.\n- `compendium_items` — magic items keyed by slug.\n- `campaigns` — campaign id, name, and DM username.\n- `campaign_characters` — party members belonging to a campaign.\n- `campaign_events` — session notes and open thread entries.\n- `play_campaigns`, `play_campaign_members`, `play_campaign_narrations` —\n  owned live-play campaigns, party membership, and DM narration events.\n\n### Routing\n\nSinatra routes are grouped by domain in `app.rb`:\n\n1. Health\n2. Core dice/checks (`/v1/dice/stats`, `/v1/checks/ability`, `/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `/v1/initiative/order`)\n3. Characters (`/v1/characters/*`)\n4. Combat state (`/v1/combat/sessions/*`)\n5. Auth users (`/v1/auth/*`)\n6. Storage (`/v1/storage/*`)\n7. Compendium (`/v1/compendium/*`)\n8. Campaigns (`/v1/campaigns/*`)\n9. PHB rules (`/v1/phb/*`)\n10. DM tools (`/v1/dm/*`)\n11. Play campaigns (`/v1/play/campaigns/*`)\n\nEvery route that returns JSON calls `content_type :json` before producing the\nbody. Validation helpers halt with `json_error(...)` which sets the\n`application/json` content type and a JSON body `{\"error\":\"...\"}`. The\n`/v1/dice/stats` route is the only validation halt that omits the explicit\ncontent type, preserving the original behavior.\n\n### Helper modules\n\nSinatra helper modules are included in `app.rb`:\n\n- `GameLogic` — pure functions (ability modifier, proficiency, initiative order,\n  encounter XP/difficulty). These methods have no side effects and can be unit\n  tested in isolation.\n- `Validation` — input guards that may `halt` with a 400 response. They depend on\n  the request context only through the `json_error` helper.\n- `Auth` — password hashing via `OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac`.\n\nApp-specific helpers live in the anonymous `helpers` block in `app.rb`:\n\n- `parse_json_body` — read and parse JSON, halt 400 on parse errors.\n- `find_combat_session!` — load a session or halt 404.\n- `combat_session_response` — format a session for the public API.\n- `json_error` — uniform JSON halt helper.\n- `encounter_calculation` — campaign-aware encounter builder that loads monsters\n  from the compendium and halts 404 if any slug is missing.\n\n## Main API/domain groupings\n\n| Group | Endpoints | Notes |\n|-------|-----------|-------|\n| Core | `POST /v1/dice/stats`, `POST /v1/checks/ability`, `POST /v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `POST /v1/initiative/order` | Deterministic math; no persistence. |\n| Characters | `POST /v1/characters/ability-modifier`, `POST /v1/characters/proficiency`, `POST /v1/characters/derived-stats` | Bounded integer validation (scores 1..30, levels 1..20). |\n| Combat | `POST /v1/combat/sessions`, `POST /v1/combat/sessions/:id/conditions`, `POST /v1/combat/sessions/:id/advance` | Stores turn order, round, turn index, and conditions with remaining rounds. |\n| Auth | `POST /v1/auth/register`, `POST /v1/auth/login` | Usernames match `/\\A[a-z0-9_-]{2,32}\\z/`. Passwords ≥ 8 chars. Roles are `dm` or `player`.
